ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, it is known that in parallelogram $OABC$, point $O$ is the coordinate vertex, point $A(3, 0)$, $C(1, 2)$, and the graph of the function $y=\frac{k}{x} \ (k\ne 0)$ passes through point $C$. Determine the value of $k$ and the equation of line $OB$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} According to the problem, point $C(1, 2)$ is on the graph of the inverse proportion function $y=\frac{k}{x}(k\ne 0)$, \\
hence $k=xy=2$, \\
since $A(3, 0)$, \\
hence $CB=OA=3$, \\
also, $CB$ is parallel to the x-axis, \\
hence $B(4, 2)$, \\
let the equation of line $OB$ be $y=ax$, \\
hence $2=4a$, \\
hence $a=\frac{1}{2}$, \\
therefore, the equation of line $OB$ is $\boxed{y=\frac{1}{2}x}$;
